title: FixtureCase
description: One evaluation case. Partition decides who may read it: `dev` is visible to the optimizer; `hold`, `guard` and `regress` never are (IR-2).

partition.description: guard is GATED, not scored: any regression rejects the candidate outright, with no statistics and no override.

workdir_seed.description: tarball or git ref restoring the starting state

outcome.description: Rule-based outcomes are strongly preferred: judge-based outcomes add noise (arXiv:2606.08275) and are hackable by the system being judged (arXiv:2607.05904).

judge_rubric.description: Only with kind=judge. A judge may rank and explain; it may never be the sole gate.

isomorphic_variants.description: Isomorphic Perturbation Testing (arXiv:2604.15149): identifier-permuted twins. Genuine generalization is invariant; shortcuts collapse. Base pass + variant fail = hard reject.

deterministic.description: temperature=0 is not determinism. Replay recorded tool I/O, freeze the clock, seed the RNG, pin the model.
